validation_rows.evidence_summary: [REVIVED] Layer-1 keyword hits on 'indirect prompt injection', 'agent CVE', 'embedded prompt', 'LLM-integration CVE' against the dormant entry's signal column — LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 (CVSS 9.1) is a server-side request forgery in the checkpoint-replay endpoint that lets attackers pivot from the LangGraph control plane to internal cloud-metadata services + adjacent agent state stores (the textbook indirect-prompt-injection-adjacent attack surface, even where the immediate vector is SSRF rather than direct prompt injection); LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 (CVSS 8.8) is an authentication bypass in the proxy admin API enabling impersonation of arbitrary virtual-key holders. Both CVEs entered the OWASP GenAI Exploit feed within hours of disclosure and Sysdig Threat Research observed honeypot exploitation within 18 hours of disclosure. Combined with the n8n Ni8mare KEV-catalog entry, the agentic-AI tooling-CVE wave now disclosing at multi-vendor weekly cadence rather than monthly, and the prompt-injection-driven-RCE pattern from prior weeks, the empirical case for indirect prompt injection as a top CVE category continues to harden.
